description: Each file under cases must fail validation against ../ipfs-mcp-config.schema.json, and the error must name the offending key (jsonschema-go reports the schema location of the failing key). Each file under semanticCases is valid JSON Schema but breaks a cross-item rule that JSON Schema cannot express; it must be rejected by the Go checks in agentic_test.go (semanticConfigError: duplicate subjects, and auth.oidc.jwks_max_stale shorter than auth.oidc.jwks_cache_ttl or zero), whose error names the key.
